SECTION 3.  Section 323.207, Tax Code, is amended to read as
  follows:
         Sec. 323.207.  STATE EXEMPTIONS APPLICABLE.  The exemptions
  provided by Subchapter H, Chapter 151, apply to the taxes
  authorized by this chapter, except as provided by Section [Sections
  151.359(j) and] 151.317(b).
         SECTION 4.  The following provisions of the Tax Code are
  repealed:
               (1)  Section 151.359;
               (2)  Section 151.3595; and
               (3)  Section 313.009.
         SECTION 5.  (a) The repeal by this Act of Sections 151.359
